intro: Between April and July 2026, ZCyberNews covered 15 high-severity incidents under the apt tag, with GopherWhisper, CyberAv3ngers, and HelloNet among the most frequently observed threat actors. These campaigns primarily targeted government, energy, cryptocurrency, technology, and business services sectors across Japan, Mongolia, Asia, Bangladesh, and Central America. The reporting period, spanning 2026-04-13 to 2026-07-16, reflects a sustained focus on advanced persistent threats.
